snippet.title: INSECTILE - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3045270/Insectile/

Find bugs, catch bugs, and piece bugs together! Explore a huge, whimsical world as a little mushroom in this clever, turn-based RPG about puzzlingly-shaped insects!

This game is being designed and developed by Narwhalnut using Godot.

Promotional art by the very talented Madalyn Curts: https://www.instagram.com/mab.tea/
